thread:
Anais: Quick heads-up — Bridgeboard + CloudMarket asked for clarity on SDK v3 deprecation and our announcement timing. They want a soft-landing path and a marketplace-safe approach.
Mike: Are we able to ship a compatibility shim in the SDK vs forcing partners to run a proxy?
Sonia: Partners will push back if this hits them during their holiday release windows. Need explicit canary + telemetry.
Jared: Shim is fine. Recommend: internal canary -> 2 partner canaries -> public announce. 60d grace window seems reasonable.
Anais: Proposed plan: ship v3.2 with opt-in legacy-headers shim behind feature flag, partner canary for 2 weeks, announcement 2 weeks after partner canary if stable. Also need migration guide + marketplace listing updates.
Mike: Implementation note: lightweight shim that maps old header X-Partner-Key -> Authorization Bearer token. Feature flag env: REDWOOD_SDK_LEGACY_HEADERS=true.
Mike: Example snippet to include in migration guide:
```diff
- headers['X-Partner-Key']
+ headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${process.env.PARTNER_TOKEN}`
```
Sonia: I'll draft partner comms. Can Bridgeboard run our integration suite against the v3.2 canary? I'll ping them.
MarketplaceBot: Draft marketplace update queued (ID: MB-4521) — review in progress.
Anais: Action items: Mike -> shim + feature flag by 2026-03-15; EngQA -> compatibility test harness; Sonia -> partner comms + schedule partner canaries; Product -> final announcement copy & legal signoff.
Mike: OK will open PR and add unit+e2e tests for header mapping.
Jared: Add telemetry events we should emit: sdk.v3_migration.start, sdk.legacy_shim.enabled, sdk.migration.failure, sdk.shim.latency.
Sonia: Add a clear opt-out/expiration date in the comms: "legacy headers supported until 2026-06-30; after that, we will remove automatic mapping" — partners want certainty.
Mike: Perf note: shim cost minimal, but we'll emit sdk.shim.latency and include in rollout dashboard.
Anais: Good. I'll create the calendar invite for a partner sync next Tue 9am PT and loop in Bridgeboard + CloudMarket PMs.
Sonia: +1 :thumbsup:
MarketplaceBot: Reminder scheduled: partner announcement calendar sync requested for 2026-04-02.
Anais: Thanks everyone — will follow up with checklist and PR links in this thread.
Mike: I'll post the PR URL here once ready.
Sonia: I'll attach the comms draft once it's ready for review.
Jared: If any partner reports failures during canary, auto-rollback plan: disable shim by turning off env flag and open incident-runbook.
Anais: Noted — include rollback steps in the partner-facing doc and internal runbook.
Sonia: Cheers, will update partners after internal QA completes.
